references.text: The spies who went up with Caleb made the people's hearts faint by saying they could not take the land, while Caleb had a different spirit.
God commends Caleb for having followed Him fully, unlike the other spies who made the people afraid.
Moses repeats that Caleb followed the Lord fully, in contrast to the generation that came out of Egypt.
Moses describes how the people became discouraged because of the spies' report about the large cities and giants.
Caleb is mentioned as the only one who will see the promised land because he followed the Lord fully.
It repeats that Caleb followed the Lord, the God of Israel, fully - the same expression is used here.
Caleb silenced the people and encouraged them to take the land, unlike the other spies.
Seeking God with all one's heart parallels Caleb's devotion to following the Lord fully.
